source.secondary: 中国签证申请服务中心官方 FAQ

label.zh:
国单方面免签
停留 30 天

text.en: Trial policy, with an expiry date. 48 of the 50 visa-free arrangements are trials running only to 31 Dec 2026. “Can I come” is a question with a shelf life — worth checking before you book.
text.zh: 试行政策，有保质期。50 国里有 48 国是「试行」，施行至 2026-12-31。「能不能来」是有有效期的，订票前值得先确认。

text.en: Most people from the 50 countries won’t need a visa at all — but the same passport can get a different answer for a different itinerary. This page only gives the ballpark. The verdict needs your specifics.
text.zh: 50 国的大多数人根本不用办签证——但同一本护照，行程不同，结论可能完全不同。这一页只给大概。 要结论得看你的具体情况。

desc.en: Weather, crowds, price. Avoid the three domestic peak weeks.
desc.zh: 天气、人流、价格。避开国内三个高峰周。

desc.en: Some hotels can only take foreign guests if licensed — most can, and we tell you how to check.
desc.zh: 部分酒店接待外国客人有资质要求——多数没问题，我们告诉你怎么确认。

desc.en: Likely not needed. If needed, allow 4–6 weeks.
desc.zh: 大概率不用办。若需要，预留 4–6 周。

desc.en: Set up payments, data, WeChat. This is where most first-timers get caught out.
desc.zh: 搞定支付、网络、微信。第一次来的人多半在这里翻车。

desc.en: Immigration card, then accommodation registration within 24 hours.
desc.zh: 入境卡，然后 24 小时内办住宿登记。
